description: Search Google Maps local businesses in real time by natural-language query (e.g. "HVAC contractors in Austin, TX") and return ratings, review counts, E.164 phone numbers, website domains, street addresses, opening hours, Place IDs, CIDs, and GPS coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / place returned ($0.20–$0.50/1K places; 0 Credits if empty).

enrich_contacts.description: Set true to crawl returned business websites in real time for public B2B emails and social profiles.

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return (1–100).

q.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. "Specialty coffee roasters in Austin, TX" or "Dental clinics in Miami, FL".

name: places_search
title: Search Google Maps Local Businesses
